raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose
`is_shared_expert_quant_fse_compatible` only recognises `DeepseekV4FP8Config`, `QuarkConfig` and `Fp8Config`, and refuses everything else, so [MiniMax-M3-MXFP8](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8) (a `ModelOptMxFp8Config` checkpoint) hits the fallthrough and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` is a no-op that only logs a warning. Shared-expert fusion was enabled for this exact model by #46545 (Jun 26) and worked until #51695 (Aug 18) introduced this refuse-by-default quantization gate, which silently turned it back off; CI missed it because `test_models_fse_init` covers `minimax_m3` but installs a `QuarkConfig`. 

This adds the missing `ModelOptMxFp8Config` branch: MXFP8 carries a single whole-model quant algo plus `exclude_modules` and no per-layer config, so consistent exclusion of routed and shared experts is exactly what guarantees the shared expert has the same weight format as the routed slot it is appended into. Partially excluded packed shards are already rejected by `is_layer_skipped`, and MXFP8 is always 1x32 block-scaled with a leading expert dimension on its scales.
## Test Plan
Serving A/B on MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, TP4 on MI355X, identical stack with and without the fix, to
show the now-reachable fused path is a win on throughput and neutral on quality: 8K/1K
throughput at concurrency 1/16/64, and gsm8k on the full 1319-doc test split, 5-shot.

## Test Result
`tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py`, run on MI355X in
`vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly`:

| arm | result |
|---|---|
| unmodified `main` | 84 passed |
| new cases, unpatched `vllm` | 5 failed, all `shared-expert FSE quantization compatibility is not implemented for ModelOptMxFp8Config` |
| patched | 89 passed |

### Serving A/B

`MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8`, TP4 on MI355X, in `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly`
(image id `d65c1f85e583`, `vllm 0.3.1.dev190+g3df4ae153`). Both arms run the same image and
the same command below; the only difference is whether this patch is applied before the
server starts. Env for both arms:

```
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1
VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
```

```bash
vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 \
    --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT \
    --language-model-only \
    --tensor-parallel-size=4 \
    --max-model-len=131072 \
    --block-size=128 \
    --kv-cache-dtype=fp8 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization=0.85 \
    --max-num-seqs=64 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens=32768 \
    '--attention-config={"backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA","indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}' \
    --moe-backend=aiter \
    --no-enable-prefix-caching \
    '--compilation-config={"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","max_cudagraph_capture_size":512}'
```

Note that `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` is set in *both* arms; without the
patch it is simply ignored, which is the bug. The logs confirm the arms really differ:
unpatched emits 228 `not implemented for ModelOptMxFp8Config` refusals (57 MoE layers x 4
ranks) and builds the aiter MoE with `128, 4` experts, patched emits none and builds
`129, 5`, the extra slot being the fused shared expert.

#### Throughput

`vllm bench serve`, random 8192-in / 1024-out, `--ignore-eos --temperature=0 --seed=42`,
10/80/320 prompts at concurrency 1/16/64:

| conc | tok/s no FSE | tok/s FSE | delta | TPOT no FSE | TPOT FSE | delta | TTFT no FSE | TTFT FSE | delta |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 121.7 | 154.4 | **+26.9%** | 8.00 ms | 6.26 ms | **-21.8%** | 234.1 ms | 233.6 ms | -0.2% |
| 16 | 988.2 | 1101.7 | **+11.5%** | 14.27 ms | 12.63 ms | **-11.5%** | 1878.5 ms | 1815.4 ms | -3.4% |
| 64 | 1841.9 | 2077.9 | **+12.8%** | 31.85 ms | 28.18 ms | **-11.5%** | 2921.1 ms | 2812.8 ms | -3.7% |

#### Accuracy

`lm_eval==0.4.12`, gsm8k full test split (1319 docs, no `--limit`), 5-shot, greedy, task
defaults otherwise. Server as above except `--max-model-len=4096`:

```bash
python3 -m lm_eval \
    --model local-completions \
    --tasks gsm8k \
    --num_fewshot 5 \
    --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024 \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path <out> \
    --model_args "base_url=http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/completions,\
model=MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3-MXFP8,tokenized_requests=False,num_concurrent=32,max_length=4096"
```

| filter | no FSE | FSE |
|---|---|---|
| strict-match | 0.8992 +/- 0.0083 | 0.8923 +/- 0.0085
| flexible-extract | 0.8992 +/- 0.0083 | 0.8931 +/- 0.0085

@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.layer import determine_expert_counts
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.experts_int8 import ExpertsInt8Config
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptMxFp8Config
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.base import OnlineQuantizationConfig
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.quark.quark import QuarkConfig
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.config_utils import (
@@ -1169,6 +1170,40 @@ def test_online_mxfp4_shared_expert_rejects_quark_weight_only_mxfp4_fse() -> Non
     )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("exclude", "expected"),
+    [
+        ([], True),
+        (["lm_head", "model.embed_tokens"], True),
+        (["*.shared_experts.*"], False),
+        (["model.layers.0.mlp.experts"], False),
+        (["model.layers.0.mlp.experts", "*.shared_experts.*"], True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_modelopt_mxfp8_shared_expert_fse_compatibility(
+    exclude: list[str], expected: bool
+) -> None:
+    """MiniMax-M3 ships MXFP8, whose exclude list decides FSE compatibility."""
+    compatible, reason = is_shared_expert_quant_fse_compatible(
+        ModelOptMxFp8Config(
+            is_checkpoint_mxfp8_serialized=True,
+            kv_cache_quant_algo=None,
+            exclude_modules=exclude,
+        ),
+        "model.layers.0.mlp.experts",
+        "model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts",
+    )
+
+    assert compatible is expected
+    if expected:
+        assert reason is None
+    else:
+        assert reason == (
+            "MXFP8 excludes routed and shared experts inconsistently at "
+            "model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts"
+        )
+
+
 def test_quark_shared_expert_fse_exclude_is_scoped_to_the_layer() -> None:
     """Excluding one layer's shared experts must not disable FSE elsewhere.

@@ -77,6 +77,7 @@ def is_shared_expert_quant_fse_compatible(
 
     """
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptMxFp8Config
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.fp8 import OnlineLinearBase
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.quark.quark import QuarkConfig
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
@@ -351,6 +352,21 @@ def is_ignored(layer_name: str) -> bool:
 
         return True, None
 
+    if isinstance(quant_config, ModelOptMxFp8Config):
+        expert_excluded = quant_config.is_layer_excluded(expert_prefix)
+        if any(
+            quant_config.is_layer_excluded(f"{shared_expert_prefix}.{projection_name}")
+            != expert_excluded
+            for projection_name in projection_names
+        ):
+            return (
+                False,
+                "MXFP8 excludes routed and shared experts inconsistently at "
+                f"{shared_expert_prefix}",
+            )
+
+        return True, None
+
     # TODO: Extend FSE support detection to other quantization methods. Typically,
     # one would check that the experts and shared_experts use the same
     # quantization config. This may be refactored as part of QuantizationConfig later.
